anti_patterns: Do not let the provenance rail's mono annotations become decorative — every instance must reference something real and checkable (an actual entity field, a real MCP/CLI call name verified against the codebase), never an invented-sounding technical label. This is the exact failure mode the draft-rendered-page skill warns about ('grep your own page for the thing your instructions point at').
Do not spread the --correction color as a general accent — it is reserved exclusively for showing a superseded value, or it stops being legible as a distinct semantic.
Do not diverge the shared structural tokens (radius, spacing, grid) from Ateles's — structural divergence plus accent divergence produces two unrelated products, not siblings.

Do not reuse the Neotoma app/Inspector's warm cream/terracotta palette — this identity's paper/ink palette is a DIFFERENT warm neutral (green-undertone ink, teal accent) chosen specifically to avoid the inspector's terracotta signature, per ruled decision public_pages_do_not_reuse_inspector_palette (plan ent_98ef9d45f8a6896fed408f8f).

border_radius.note: KEPT VERBATIM: 10px cards/panels, 8px buttons, 999px toggle pill — same as shared design_system.

positioning_principles: Record properties get visual devices, not prose: versioned/attributed/correctable/replayable each map to a specific move (provenance rail = attributed; visible correction mark = correctable; the rail's dated annotations = versioned/replayable) rather than being asserted in copy alone.

Provenance rail (signature move): a persistent left-edge marginalia column in JetBrains Mono, 11px, +0.02em tracking, --ink-3 color, annotating major content blocks with a real field/entity/mechanism reference — e.g. 'retrieve_field_provenance()' beside a corrections claim, 'at_ingested≠at' beside a time-travel claim. Pure CSS grid + static text, no JS required; this is the single most load-bearing device, unique to Neotoma.

Visible correction (signature move): one boundary-table row renders a struck-through prior value beside its current replacement, in the dedicated --correction color, literally showing correction rather than describing correctability.

Iconography: a small set of inline-SVG 'register marks' (corner-fold tick, corrected-value asterisk-in-circle, attributed-value filled square) replacing the single generic Feather-style line icon currently shared visually with Ateles — quoted SVG attributes throughout per draft-rendered-page's lesson on unquoted numeric attrs silently dropping shapes.
Color as paper/ink, not accent-on-white: light mode is warm aged-paper (#f6f3ea) over near-black green-undertone ink, not clinical white — the physical register metaphor, not a UI theme.
identity.scope: Neotoma product pages only (distinct from the shared structural design_system ent_72e01f1008653b601be1a956, which this entity does NOT replace or overwrite). A DESIGNED, not-yet-applied identity: derives its signature devices from Neotoma's category as 'the system of record for AI agents' — versioned, attributed, correctable, replayable — rather than from a generic dev-tool palette. Siblings with, not twins of, the Ateles identity (ent to be linked): shares the existing structural system (10px radius, 1080px maxw, identical spacing scale) but diverges in accent palette, the JOB assigned to the monospace type family, and one signature move (a continuous left-edge 'provenance rail') that has no Ateles equivalent because attribution-over-time is specifically a record property, not an authority property.

spacing_system.note: KEPT VERBATIM from the shared design_system ent_72e01f1008653b601be1a956 — 10px card/panel radius via --radius, --maxw:1080px, identical section/hero padding, .cap grid (10px 1fr/22px gap/28px 0 padding), .btn padding 11px 20px. Deliberate: the brief instructs shared structural skeleton with per-product accent/type/signature divergence, not full structural fork — diverging the skeleton too would produce two unrelated products rather than siblings.

color_palette.rationale: Paper/ink metaphor (not a generic accent-on-white SaaS scheme): a record's oldest technology is the page. Teal retained as seed hue from the current live palette (evolutionary, not a rebrand) but restructured. 'correction' is a NEW semantic color role, reserved exclusively for showing a superseded value struck through beside its replacement (signature move 4) — never reused as a UI accent, so it stays unambiguous.

wcag_aa_verified_2026_09_21.method: relative-luminance WCAG contrast formula computed directly (python), all 10 pairs exceed 4.5:1 AA-normal-text threshold, none borderline

type_scale.google_fonts_licence: All three (Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono) are free, open-license Google Fonts already loaded via @import on the live page — no cost, no licensing action needed.
type_scale.rationale: Family kept deliberately: research fetched 2026-09-21 (fontsinuse.com/typefaces/171187/jetbrains-mono, designmd.app/library/fraunces-typography) confirms Fraunces' 'actual warmth... ink pressed into good paper' character is already the correct register for permanent record vs. ephemeral chat, and Fraunces+mono is a recognized editorial+technical pairing. What changes is JetBrains Mono's ROLE: elevated from near-unused code font (0 <code> elements on the live page) to the carrier of the provenance rail (signature move) — every claim gets a small mono-set marginalia annotation (field name, entity_id, or a real mechanism call like retrieve_field_provenance()), distinguishing CONTENT typography from PROVENANCE typography the way an archival document distinguishes body text from marginalia.
